desc:
🌍 Build a civilization. Raise a dynasty. Become a legend! 🏰

Found your own town, gather wood and stone, and grow your Town Hall from a tiny wooden hut into the heart of a nation. Pick a job (Farmer 🌽, Engineer 🔨, Hunter 🏹, Barber ✂️, Tailor 🧵, Warrior 🛡️), craft tools, and build walls, gates and shops!

🧬 Every life is different! You grow up, have a family, and pass your genes to your children. Some people awaken rare powers:
⚡ Super Speed  💪 Super Strength  🕊️ Flight
🧠 Telekinesis  👥 Duplication  🌀 Reality Bending  ☀️ Sun Manipulation

🌦️ Survive the seasons from sunny summers to snowy winters, keep your health and hunger up, and defend what you've built.

Will you protect your people, lead a nation, or wander the world as a nomad?

⭐ Like & favorite to support the game!
💬 Join our Discord for updates and news!
